proof_summary: Take \(N=8181818181818181818181818181818181818181818181818182\); then \(11N=9\cdot10^{52}+2\), whose decimal digit sum is \(11\). For any multiplier satisfying \(k=s_{10}(kN)\), the bounds \(s_{10}(kN)\le 9(\operatorname{digits}(k)+52)\) force \(k<500\), and a direct check below 500 leaves only \(k=0,11\); hence the maximum is \(11<12\), giving the counterexample.
